items.q: What is GEO and why does it matter for my site?
items.a: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) optimizes your site to appear in AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity. Unlike SEO which targets Google, GEO targets AI search engines, which are capturing a growing share of traffic. If your site isn't readable by these AIs, you're invisible to an entire generation of users.

items.q: Is it really free? Why?
items.a: Yes, the score analysis is 100% free, no signup, no credit card. We offer this first diagnostic to show you exactly where you stand. If your score reveals weaknesses, our paid audits (€29 or €99) give you the precise recommendations to fix them. No catch: you decide whether to go further.

items.q: What's the difference between the 1-page audit (€29) and the full audit (€99)?
items.a: The 1-page audit analyzes one URL with 10 ChatGPT queries and delivers technical recommendations + a PDF. Perfect for your key page. The full audit covers 10 pages, 30 queries, advanced AI recommendations and a projected score after optimization. Choose €29 to start fast, €99 for a complete view.

items.q: What's a good GEO score?
items.a: Our score runs from 0 to 100. Below 40, your site is nearly invisible to AIs. Between 40 and 70, you have partial presence with clear room for improvement. Above 70, you're well positioned. Most unoptimized sites score between 20 and 45.

items.q: How is this different from asking ChatGPT directly?
items.a: ChatGPT can give generic advice, but it can't analyze your site in real time, measure your GEO score, simulate real queries against your content, or deliver a structured report with precise actions. Detekia does all of this automatically, reproducibly, with objective metrics.

items.q: Are the results reliable?
items.a: Our method is based on real queries sent to the ChatGPT API and a structured analysis of how AIs understand and cite your content. It's not a theoretical estimate, it's a real-conditions test. The PDF report documents every criterion analyzed, transparently and verifiably.

items.q: What do I actually receive after an audit?
items.a: You receive a full PDF report with your detailed score, identified weaknesses, and concrete recommendations (meta tag edits, content structure, structured data). Most actions can be applied without a developer. If you use a CMS (WordPress, Webflow…), you can implement them directly.

items.q: Where should I start if I don't know which audit to choose?
items.a: Start with the free score, it gives you a first read in under a minute. If your score is low and you have one priority page (homepage, service page, product page), the 1-page audit at €29 is the best entry point. If you want a full picture to prioritize your efforts, go straight to the full audit at €99.

steps.title: Content scraping
steps.desc: Detekia retrieves the full HTML of your page via a specialized AI scraping service. The raw HTML, text and metadata are extracted.

steps.title: Heuristic analysis
steps.desc: Our analysis engine computes 7 heuristic scores by inspecting the DOM: tags, attributes, ratios, counts. These scores are reproducible and deterministic.

steps.title: AI analysis
steps.desc: Our AI analysis engine evaluates the text content to assess editorial neutrality and generate contextualized recommendations. The final score incorporates this result.

score.label: Score calculation
score.title: Score out of 100 = 7 heuristics + AI neutrality
score.subtitle: The first 7 criteria are calculated by deterministic rules on the HTML. The 8th criterion (editorial neutrality) is scored by Claude out of 10, then converted into a -3 to +3 point bonus/penalty added to the total.

items.name: Extractability & direct answer
items.what: AI models look for "ready-to-cite" answers in your content. A good website answers the question in the first few lines, with lists, tables and clear headings.
items.good: Intro that directly answers in 1-2 sentences, bullet lists, data tables, logical H2/H3 structure, short paragraphs (50-300 characters).
items.bad: Generic introduction with no direct answer, dense text blocks, no lists or tables, flat structure with no hierarchy.

items.name: Verifiability & evidence
items.what: AI models prioritize content that backs up its claims: sourced figures, precise dates, links to primary sources, citations.
items.good: Figures with sources, explicit dates, external links to studies or reference organizations, comparison tables, expert quotes.
items.bad: Unsourced claims ("it has been proven that..."), missing or unsourced figures, no external links, no publication date.

items.name: E-E-A-T Authority
items.what: E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) is the framework AI models use to evaluate the credibility of a website and its authors.
items.good: Author page with bio and photo, "author" schema in JSON-LD, detailed About page, Contact page, complete legal notices, Organization schema.
items.bad: Anonymous content with no identified author, no About or Contact page, no legal notices, no schema.org for entities.

items.name: AI Crawlability
items.what: AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot) need to be able to read your website. A blocked or poorly accessible site cannot be indexed.
items.good: Lang attribute defined, correct canonical, content not blocked by JavaScript, AI bots mentioned in robots.txt or headers, sitemap.xml.
items.bad: Meta robots noindex, content loaded only via client-side JS without SSR, missing lang attribute, redirect loops, no canonical.

items.name: Structured data
items.what: Schema.org is the language AI models read first to understand what your website is about, who wrote it, and what it covers.
items.good: FAQPage, Article, HowTo, Organization, Person schemas in JSON-LD. Priority schemas (FAQPage, HowTo) are particularly valued.
items.bad: No schema.org, incorrect or incomplete schemas, missing schemas for key entities (Organization, Author).

items.name: Editorial neutrality
items.what: AI models avoid citing overly promotional or biased content. Factual, nuanced text is far more likely to be used as a source.
items.good: Informative and factual tone, nuances present, sourced claims, precise vocabulary without excessive superlatives.
items.bad: Unsourced superlatives ("the best", "revolutionary"), unproven claims, purely promotional tone, lack of nuance.

items.name: External presence
items.what: AI models cross-reference multiple sources to evaluate your credibility. Being mentioned in the press or cited on other websites strengthens your perceived authority.
items.good: Press mentions with links, active presence on LinkedIn/Twitter, referenced testimonials and reviews, citations in third-party articles.
items.bad: No identifiable inbound links, no social media presence, no press or third-party mentions.

items.name: Freshness & maintenance
items.what: For evolving topics, AI models prefer recent content. A visible update date and current copyright signal that the website is actively maintained.
items.good: dateModified in JSON-LD, visible update date, current year copyright, recent content in meta tags.
items.bad: No visible date, copyright from 3+ years ago, missing dateModified schema, articles without publication date.

items.title: Page-level analysis
items.desc: Detekia analyzes precisely the page you submit (homepage by default, or any other URL of your site), not the entire site. For most sites, the homepage concentrates the global signals (robots.txt, Organization schema, authority, social presence) and provides a representative diagnostic. To analyze multiple pages with a consolidated report, see our complete audit.

items.title: Non-measurable factors
items.desc: Intrinsic content quality, offline reputation, inbound backlinks, and AI citation history cannot be measured by our technical analysis.

items.title: Algorithm evolution
items.desc: AI citation criteria evolve regularly. Our methodology is updated but may lag behind the latest practices of AI models.

items.title: Dynamic websites
items.desc: Websites that load their content entirely via client-side JavaScript (SPA without SSR) may receive underestimated scores because the content isn't accessible to the scraper.

sections.title: Your rights
content: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
Right of access. You may request a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
Right to rectification. You may request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to erasure. You may request the deletion of your personal data. For emails collected via the capture form, deletion is immediate upon request.
Right to object. You may object to the processing of your data at any time.
Right to data portability. You may request to receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Right to withdraw consent. For processing based on consent (email capture), you may withdraw your consent at any time.
To exercise any of these rights, send an email to hello@detekia.fr specifying your request. We will respond within a maximum of 30 days.
If you believe that the processing of your data does not comply with regulations, you may file a complaint with the CNIL (French data protection authority): www.cnil.fr.

sections.title: Data transfers outside the EU
paragraphs: Some of our processors are located in the United States (Vercel, Resend, our AI provider). These transfers are governed by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, recognized by the European Commission as providing an adequate level of protection (adequacy decision of July 10, 2023).
Payment data is processed by Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd., established in Ireland (EU).
Cache data (URLs, analysis results) is stored in the eu-west-1 region (EU).

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Beeleven SASU implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against loss, theft, unauthorized access, disclosure or destruction. Communications are encrypted via HTTPS/TLS. Database access is protected by authentication.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This privacy policy may be updated at any time. The last update date is indicated at the top of this page. We encourage you to check this page regularly.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: For any questions regarding the protection of your data: hello@detekia.fr

Extractibilité & réponse directe.title: Extractability & direct answer
Extractibilité & réponse directe.desc: AI models look for "ready-to-cite" answers in your content. If your text answers clearly in the first few lines, with lists and tables, AI can extract and reuse it easily.

Vérifiabilité & preuves.title: Verifiability & evidence
Vérifiabilité & preuves.desc: AI models prioritize content that backs up its claims: sourced figures, precise dates, links to primary sources.

Autorité & E-E-A-T.title: Authority & E-E-A-T
Autorité & E-E-A-T.desc: E-E-A-T stands for Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness. AI models favor websites with identified authors, bios, and clear About/Contact pages.

Crawlabilité IA.title: AI Crawlability
Crawlabilité IA.desc: AI models like ChatGPT use bots (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot) to read your website. If your content is hidden behind JavaScript or blocked in robots.txt, these bots can't index it.

Données structurées.title: Structured data (Schema.org)
Données structurées.desc: Schema.org is a language AI models read first. It explicitly tells them what your website is about, who wrote it, and what it covers.

Neutralité éditoriale.title: Editorial neutrality
Neutralité éditoriale.desc: AI models avoid citing overly promotional or biased content. Factual, nuanced text is far more likely to be used as a source.

Présence externe.title: External presence
Présence externe.desc: AI models cross-reference multiple sources to evaluate your credibility. Being mentioned in the press or on social media strengthens your perceived authority.

Fraîcheur & maintenance.title: Freshness & maintenance
Fraîcheur & maintenance.desc: For evolving topics, AI models prefer recent content. A visible update date and current copyright signal that your website is actively maintained.
